title: Valid Samples
description: A page whose samples compile against the real types.
---

A lede that stands on its own, because an agent reads it first.

## Overview

Every sample carries its own import line, so it stands alone.

```ts
import { text } from "plumix/fields";

export const subtitle = text("subtitle").label("Subtitle").maxLength(120);
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "plumix/admin/react";

export function Counter() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  return <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>{count}</button>;
}
```

## Quickstart

Both samples above stand on their own.
